description: Rejection fixture reproducing the lane C1 failure mode: content the source does not supply, which runPleadingQa passes because QA reads relief vocabulary, template grade, the footer and seal markers rather than truth.
statedFailureReason: The fixture asserts that the court has already found the agency non-compliant when the packet records that non-compliance is alleged and never adjudicated, reports a hearing and a granted petition, states the respondent agency's position for it, states a filing fee the source does not establish and names it in words as an established amount, asserts completed service when the rule for service on a Nebraska state agency or political subdivision was never surveyed, and populates the protected docket number, OTN and judge fields.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the court has already found the respondent agency non-compliant with the Security, Privacy, and Dissemination of Criminal History Information Act. The packet records that non-compliance is alleged and never adjudicated.
expectedSignals.rule: Non-compliance is alleged, never adjudicated. This Petition alleges that the record remains public notwithstanding the sealing duty; it never asserts that a court has found non-compliance, and it never states the respondent's position.

expectedSignals.violation: Reports that a hearing was held and that the petition was granted, adjudicating the non-compliance the Petition may only allege.
expectedSignals.rule: Non-compliance is alleged, never adjudicated. This Petition alleges that the record remains public notwithstanding the sealing duty; it never asserts that a court has found non-compliance, and it never states the respondent's position.

expectedSignals.violation: States that the State does not object and that the respondent agency consents. The packet records that the respondent's position is never stated.
expectedSignals.rule: Non-compliance is alleged, never adjudicated. This Petition alleges that the record remains public notwithstanding the sealing duty; it never asserts that a court has found non-compliance, and it never states the respondent's position.

expectedSignals.violation: States a dollar amount for the filing fee and asserts it was paid on a date. No committed Nebraska evidence establishes a fee for a § 29-3528 action.
expectedSignals.rule: Filing fee: no fee is established at source for a § 29-3528 action. No amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk of the district court.

expectedSignals.violation: Names the fee in words as an established amount ('filing fee of 82 dollars') when the source establishes none.
expectedSignals.rule: Filing fee: no fee is established at source for a § 29-3528 action. No amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk of the district court.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the Petition was duly served on the respondent agency on a stated date and that service was completed. The rule for service on a Nebraska state agency or political subdivision was never surveyed, no certificate of service is drafted and no service method is asserted.
expectedSignals.rule: The rule for service on a Nebraska state agency or political subdivision was not surveyed. No certificate of service is drafted and no service method is asserted; confirm the rule with the clerk or counsel before filing.

expectedSignals.violation: Populates caseData.docketNumber, caseData.otn and caseData.judgeName, which the protected-field policy requires to stay blank in every fixture.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated docket number reaches the caption in place of the blank-docket placeholder.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated OTN reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated judge name reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Action under Neb. Rev. Stat. § 29-3528 to compel compliance with the sealing duty
additionalFacts: The Court finds that the respondent agency has failed to comply with the Security, Privacy, and Dissemination of Criminal History Information Act.
The State does not object to this Petition and the respondent agency consents to the relief requested.
A hearing was held on 03/20/2026 and the petition was granted.
Petitioner paid the filing fee of 82 dollars ($82) to the clerk of the district court on 02/14/2026.
A copy of this Petition was duly served on the respondent agency on 03/01/2026, and service was completed that day.
